title: Birth in Chicago and his father's travelling work
summary: Jones gives his birth date (October 7, 1911), his parents' names, and says his father, a government artificer, was shifted around the country.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: This 'Section' is that Jo Jones and I used to have a rhythm section; we're section partners. Well, Jo, what I think would be interesting to do I guess would be to start at the beginning. Where were you born, Jo?
And what year was that now, about?
October 7, 1911. I believe it was on a Wednesday.
Heh-heh-heh, that's good, on a Wednesday.
Your parents' names were what, Jo?
Jones. Do you know about where they were living in Chicago?

At that precise time I would not and I could not possibly know; because of the nature of my father's work, which I wasn't any too familiar with, he was being shifted around in various parts of the United States and to my recollection -

No, he was connected with the Government and he was what is known as an artificer. In other words, aside from being an electrician, building boats and things, and you must remember the social conditions being at that particular time, it was very difficult to find an outlet for him but due to his flair of what he knew, first he was going to settle into Pittsburgh; they thought that he would go. He eventually - that's how I became to go to Alabama, you see.
